# Read the Galaxy API key
with open('/run/secrets/galaxy_api_key', 'r') as f:
    api_key = f.read().strip()

os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY'] = api_key
os.environ['GALAXY_SERVER'] = 'https://usegalaxy.org'

import bioblend.galaxy
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)

# Copy the seed history
seed_history_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b59df98902ce5f37e2'
new_hist = gi.histories.copy_history(seed_history_id, name='analysis-copy')
print(f"New history ID: {new_hist['id']}")
print(f"New history name: {new_hist['name']}")

# Save the new history ID for later use
with open('/workspace/new_history_id.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_hist['id'])

# Now download the CSV file from the new history
contents = gi.histories.show_history(new_hist['id'], contents=True)
for item in contents:
    if item['name'].endswith('.csv'):
        dataset_id = item['id']
        print(f"CSV dataset ID: {dataset_id}")
        gi.datasets.download_dataset(dataset_id, file_path='/workspace/inputs/Pseudomonas_aeruginosa_UCBPP-PA14.csv', wait_for_completion=True, maxwait=60)
        print("CSV downloaded successfully")
    elif item['name'].endswith('.rds'):
        print(f"RDS dataset: {item['name']} ID: {item['id']}")
